title: EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio
claim: EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio — Web dashboard for Hermes Agent — multi-platform AI chat, session management, scheduled jobs, usage analytics
why_good: A control-room dashboard for running an AI agent across chat platforms — sessions, cron jobs, usage analytics: the ops layer teams need once agents go live.
value: Charge a team/hosted tier: multi-seat management, scheduling, analytics and support for agents in production.
risk: Tied to one 'Hermes' agent; without breadth it's a companion tool the underlying agent or a framework absorbs.
pick_reason: The project offers a clear product for managing AI chat agents with potential for monetization through subscription or usage fees.
